## savePublicKeySync() function

Save a public key to the user's home directory (sync).

This saves the public key as a base64-encoded string (matching the format in config.yaml) to \~/.attest-it/public-keys/<slug>.pem for backup purposes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function savePublicKeySync(slug: string, publicKey: string): SavePublicKeyResult;
```
